info.name: Genscape Oil Transportation
info.description:
Crude oil transportation data for pipelines and rail terminals located in North America and Europe. This data currently includes:

- Half-hourly, daily, weekly, and monthly individual pipeline flows
    
- Half-hourly, daily, and weekly regional net pipeline flows
    
- Daily, weekly and monthly rail flows
    
- Pipeline regulatory data
    
- Half-hourly station-level megawatt data
    
- Pipeline metadata
    
- Pipeline alerts
    
- Pipeline tariffs
    
- North American waterborne crude shipments
